category: Test AI Data and Pipeline Integrity (PW)
subcategory_text: Test datasets, training pipelines, and retrieval pipelines for integrity issues (data poisoning, leakage, distribution shift, retrieval corruption) that could degrade model security or behaviour.
implementation_examples: Detect poisoned training samples via outlier and influence-function analysis
Audit retrieval indices for unauthorised content injection
Monitor training-data lineage against declared provenance
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data-integrity tests are part of the pipeline.
Determine whether retrieval pipelines are audited.
